slots.brief: Give a snapshot graph (y vs x at t=0) of a sinusoidal wave; ask to read amplitude, wavelength and then frequency/wave speed from the standard wave equation matched to the diagram.
Wire stretched to a given multiple of original length (volume constant); find ratio of new to original resistance, then compare power dissipated at same voltage across both.
Two gate circuit (e.g. NAND with inputs tied); build truth table and identify the equivalent single gate.
Particle with given position and velocity vectors; compute angular momentum about the origin via L = r × p.
Flux given as a polynomial in t; find induced emf at a specific instant by differentiating.
Find minimum radius of a wire to support a given load without exceeding breaking stress; one-step stress = F/A.
Given path difference (or position on screen with d, D), convert to phase difference and find I/I_max at that point.
Ice at 0°C mixed with water at higher temperature; track latent heat plus sensible heat exchange to find final temperature or unmelted ice mass.
Object moved toward a concave mirror; use mirror formula with sign convention to find image position and magnification.
Hydrogen atom in n = 4 (or given) state; count distinct emission lines possible and find shortest-wavelength transition.
Given a relation involving an unknown quantity, deduce the dimensional formula of the unknown (e.g. from a force or energy equation).
Zener regulator circuit with source, series resistor, Zener voltage and load; find current through Zener and through load, and dissipated Zener power; include circuit diagram.
Compare rms speeds of two gases (e.g. H₂ vs O₂) at same temperature using v ∝ 1/√M; pick the ratio.

slots.subtopic: Moment of inertia of point masses
slots.brief: Point masses at corners of a square/light rod; find moment of inertia about a given axis through the system.
Charged capacitor connected to an uncharged one; compute common potential and heat lost in the process.
Given masses of parent nucleus and daughter nucleus + neutron, compute separation energy in MeV; multi-step mass-defect handling.
Pendulum taken to a place where g changes by a small percentage (or with small error in length); find percentage change in T using differentials.
Given momentum and mass (or KE), use KE = p²/2m to find the other quantity in one step.
Three non-parallel forces in equilibrium; resolve components to find unknown force magnitude/angle.
Potential given as V(x) or V = a/r² + b/r; find electric field via E = −dV/dr and evaluate at a point.

slots.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
slots.brief: Same accelerating potential applied to electron vs proton (or two KEs); compare de Broglie wavelengths via λ ∝ 1/√(mK).
Cycle with simple geometric shapes (triangle/rectangle) on P–V axes; compute net work done in the cycle from the enclosed area.
Compare excess pressure inside two soap bubbles of different radii, or work done to blow a bubble using surface energy.
Body under uniform acceleration from rest; distance in the nth second given, find total distance or acceleration.
Projectile launched upward; find escape-speed fraction or speed at a given height using energy conservation with GMm/r form.
Given y = αx − βx², compare with the standard parabolic trajectory to extract u, θ and range.
Long solenoid with given turns per length and current; find B inside, then force on a small current element placed inside.

slots.subtopic: Radiation pressure / momentum of EM waves
slots.brief: EM wave of given intensity striking a surface (perfectly reflecting or absorbing); find radiation pressure/force via I/c or 2I/c.
Car on a level circular track; find minimum coefficient of friction for a given speed and radius, or maximum speed without skidding.
Series LCR at resonance: express Q in terms of R, L, C and compute it, then relate to sharpness/bandwidth symbolically.
Give an unsymmetrical internal alkene and ask the two carbonyl fragments formed on ozonolysis (reductive work-up).
Figure shows an unsymmetrical ether; ask which alcohol/alkyl iodide forms when cleaved by excess hot HI, and why the cleavage site is chosen.
Ask to rank given carbocations by stability, including one benzylic, one allylic, one vinyl-type case.
Equal molality of two given solutes; compare boiling point elevation considering dissociation/association (van 't Hoff factor).
Ask which of a set of given species has the highest/l lowest bond angle, with brief VSEPR reasoning.
Rank given elements by first ionisation enthalpy, exploiting the half-filled/filled orbital anomaly.
Two statements about reducing/non-reducing sugars and glycosidic linkage; decide if each is true and whether the second explains the first.
Statements about components of photochemical smog (ozone, PAN, NO2); identify the correct combination.
Give formula [Co(NH3)4Cl2]+ type; count/identify the geometrical isomers possible.
Given K for a reaction, ask K for the reversed reaction and/or multiplied stoichiometry; pure manipulation, no numbers.
Predict hybridisation/shape of PCl5-like phosphorus halide or its hydrolysis product; simple structure recall.
Ask number of octahedral/tetrahedral voids per atom in fcc, or the formula of a compound from void occupancy.
Use Λm = Λ°m − K√c type data (or similar) to find molar conductivity at a given concentration.
Ask how specific conductance behaves on dilution and why molar conductivity increases; statement/option based.
Statements on solubility and thermal decomposition of group 2 sulphates/carbonates; identify correct ones.
Figure shows d-orbital shapes; ask which orbital is shown (dx²−y² etc.) or which orbitals point along axes.
Match artificial sweeteners with their use/observation (saccharin, aspartame, etc.); simple fact recall.
Give a named-reaction description (Cannizzaro) and ask the products from a given aldehyde lacking α-H; identify major/minor products.
Complete hydrolysis products of PCl3/SiCl4-type covalent halides; identify which gives fumes and why.
Compute ΔH of a gaseous reaction using given bond enthalpies; moderate bookkeeping of bonds broken/formed.
Graph of [A] vs t or concentration ratio; ask how many half-lives elapsed for a given concentration drop (first order).
Percentage composition → empirical formula → molecular formula from molar mass.
Ask to rank given alkenes by heat of hydrogenation (most stable = least exothermic).
Given ion (e.g., Mn2+ or a 3d ion), count unpaired electrons; simple electronic configuration application.
Figure shows a substituted benzene with side chain; ask product of KMnO4 oxidation of side chain (regardless of chain length).
Compare two given complexes differing only in ligand field strength; predict high-spin vs low-spin and number of unpaired electrons.
Figure shows a sequence starting from aniline → diazonium → product; fill in intermediate reagents needed for a given conversion.
Convert a phenol to anisole-like ether in 2–3 steps; identify correct reagent sequence (NaOH, CH3I/Williamson, etc.).
Dehydrohalogenation of a given alkyl halide with alc. KOH; ask major Saytzeff vs Hofmann product.
Compute ionisation potential/radius/energy for hydrogen-like ion (He+, Li2+) using Bohr formula scaling with Z and n.
Give a sentence using a common idiom (e.g. 'to beat about the bush'); ask the student to pick the closest meaning from the options.
Four jumbled sentences on a simple descriptive topic; the first sentence is fixed in place and students arrange the remaining three (PQR-style).
Pick a moderately common word (e.g. 'candid', 'frugal') and ask students to choose its nearest synonym from four options.
A short sentence split into parts (A/B/C/D) with a clear subject-verb agreement error; students identify the erroneous part.
A simple sentence with one blank; four everyday vocabulary options, only one of which fits the context naturally.
A grammatically correct sentence testing prepositions/gerund usage, split into parts; correct answer is 'No error'.
Pick a common word (e.g. 'obsolete', 'hostile') used in a short sentence and ask for its antonym from four options.
Give an active voice sentence in simple past or present perfect tense; ask students to choose the correct passive form from four options.
Two statements with overlapping middle term; give four conclusions including one either-or pair and a possibility conclusion; ask which conclusions definitely follow.
Letter pair analogy where letters shift by a fixed positional distance (e.g., AB : ED type); student must find the pair following the same pattern.
Mixed alpha-numeric series where letters follow one rule and numbers another (e.g., add 2 to letters, add 5 to digits); find the next term.
A word is coded by shifting each letter a specific number of positions; apply the same rule to a new word to get the code.
Three statements involving 'some', 'all' and 'no' with a tricky middle term; ask which of the given conclusions logically follows, testing valid venn placements.
Sentences coded word-by-word; identify the code of a word by comparing two coded sentences that share exactly one common word.
A conversation-style statement ('pointing to a photo, he said his mother's brother...') asking how the person is related to the one pointing; require a two-step chain.
Four words where three share a common category (e.g., three are fruits, one is a vegetable, or three are types of buildings) - pick the one that doesn't belong.
Simple ranking of 5-6 people by height or weight with direct comparison statements; determine who is tallest / middle of the order.
Arrange four/five words in dictionary order and identify the first, second or last word as per the question.
From the letters of a given word (each letter used as many times as it appears), determine which of the given words can or cannot be formed.

Family tree with three generations involving a grandfather, his sons/daughters and grandchildren; from a relational statement figure out how X is related to Y (e.g., 'father's sister's son' type chain).
Number series following a clear pattern (e.g., squares or alternating operations) with one incorrect term placed; identify the wrong term.
Find the shortest distance between two skew lines given in Cartesian form; pure formula plug-in with a small simplification.
Find the perpendicular distance between two parallel lines given in general form; single formula application.
Use |z1z2| = |z1||z2| and conjugate properties to evaluate a modulus expression involving products of complex numbers given in x+iy form.
Given two terms of an AP, find the sum of the first n terms; light simultaneous solving.
Count 4-digit numbers with distinct digits formed from a given digit set satisfying a parity/divisibility-style restriction; split into cases.
Definite integral of a rational function in sin/cos or a rational function requiring substitution and symmetry; moderate simplification.
Simplify (1/z̄) or an expression like (1−z)/(1−z̄) using conjugate properties to get a clean form involving modulus.
Given a two-way/percentage breakdown, compute a conditional probability of one event given the other; direct formula with the joint probability.
Given an ellipse relation or endpoints of axes, find its eccentricity using a² = b²(1−e²).
Solve a first-order linear ODE dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) with an integrating factor; identify P, multiply, integrate.
Given a relation between roots (e.g., one root is k times the other), find a parameter using sum and product of roots.
A 3×3 matrix is given as symmetric/skew-symmetric mix: test which statements about A, Aᵀ and their combination are true; no heavy computation.
Evaluate a determinant whose entries are expressions by splitting rows into sums and factoring out common factors.
Area between a parabola/line and a line, or two curves; set up integrals with limits from intersection points.
Find the domain of a composite or quotient function by intersecting positivity/non-negativity conditions under a square root or log.
Reduce a general second-degree equation in x, y to standard form and identify the conic with its centre/focus; easy completing of squares.
Find the derivative of an inverse trig expression combined with a log or rational function; simplify before differentiating.
Line through a point has given direction ratios; compute its direction cosines (with l²+m²+n²=1) or the angle with an axis.
Evaluate a limit of the form (1−cos kx)/x² or sin(ax)/sin(bx) using standard trigonometric limits.
Find the equation of the parabola with a given vertex and axis, or a circle passing through points; write the standard equation.
Count selections/arrangements where at least one condition holds, using total minus the complementary cases.
Find the general solution of a simple trigonometric equation like sin x = cos 2x or tan 2x = cot x; state the full family of solutions.
Simplify a nested expression like tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y or cot⁻¹ of a fraction using principal-value identities, being careful with branch.
Binomial-style: probability of exactly k successes in n trials, or a two-step probability tree; compute directly with care.
Given a small data set with a known mean/SD, find the new variance when each observation is transformed (shift/scale).

slots.subtopic: Cross product and angle between vectors
slots.brief: Use |a×b|² + (a·b)² = |a|²|b|² or dot/cross relation to find an unknown dot product given magnitudes and the cross product magnitude.
Determine whether a given piecewise-defined or rational function is one-one/onto, or check reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity of a relation on a small set.
Piecewise function with parameter k: find k and possibly another constant so the function is continuous at the joining point.
Find intervals where a polynomial or rational function is increasing/decreasing by solving f′(x) > 0; requires factorisation of the derivative.
Solve a homogeneous differential equation dy/dx = f(y/x) using the substitution y = vx, then find the particular solution through a given point.
Equation of a line through the intersection point of two given lines with an additional condition (slope/parallel/perpendicular to a given line) using the family L1 + λL2 = 0.
Use dy ≈ f′(x)dx to estimate the error or percentage error in a computed quantity (e.g., side/cube/sphere).
Prove/verify a compound-angle or double-angle identity numerically: given sin/cos of one angle, evaluate a double-angle or half-angle expression.
Definite integral over [−a, a] of an even/odd mix, or one needing a substitution t = f(x) that flips limits; combine symmetry with a standard result.
Find the coefficient of a specified xᵏ in (a + bx)ⁿ or a binomial product; use the general term with the exponent condition.
Sum a series whose nth term is a difference of fractions (telescoping), such as 1/(n(n+k)), as n → n terms; find the closed form.
Number of functions/one-one functions/onto functions from a small set A to B using nᵐ and inclusion considerations.
Straightforward 3×3 (or 2×2) determinant evaluation, or adjoint relation |adj A| = |A|ⁿ⁻¹; one clean computation.
Indefinite integral of a product requiring integration by parts (log × polynomial or inverse-trig form); identify u and dv correctly.
Given position vectors of points, check collinearity or find a unit vector along a line/median; direct computation from formulas.
